## Resource or correction

Describe the concrete robotics task and primary evidence.

## Metadata and generation

- [ ] English summary and equivalent Chinese explanation are present.
- [ ] Canonical URL, taxonomy, relevance and license scope are accurate or explicitly unknown.
- [ ] Observed dates and provenance are preserved.
- [ ] Source/review inputs and generated files are updated together.
- [ ] Schema/consistency validation and ranking tests pass.
- [ ] No credentials, private records or deployment configuration are included.

Changes to the ranking graph or algorithm must explain their source and effect separately from editorial inclusion.
